builder.starterSettingsSubtitle: Configure this template's runtime options without editing TypeScript or JSON.
builder.setting.respond_on_mention.label: Reply on @-mention
builder.setting.respond_on_mention.descr: Answer when a group member @-mentions the bot.
builder.setting.respond_on_reply.label: Reply when replied to
builder.setting.respond_on_reply.descrip: Answer when a group member quotes or replies to one of the bot's messages without @-tagging it.
builder.setting.respond_in_c2c.label: Reply in C2C private chats
builder.setting.respond_in_c2c.descripti: Answer 1-on-1 private QQ messages sent directly to the bot.
builder.setting.respond_in_guild.label: Reply in QQ Guild / channel DMs
builder.setting.respond_in_guild.descrip: Answer @-mentions in QQ Guild channels and guild DMs.
builder.setting.respond_in_dm.label: Reply in direct messages
builder.setting.respond_in_dm.descriptio: Answer private 1-on-1 messages sent directly to the bot.
builder.setting.bot_names.label: Bot names / aliases
builder.setting.bot_names.description: Comma-separated names or nicknames that wake the bot in plain text without @ (used together with its bot username).
builder.setting.trigger_phrase.label: Trigger phrase
builder.setting.trigger_phrase.descripti: Optional case-insensitive keyword or prefix (for example !bot) that wakes the bot without an @-mention.
builder.setting.reply_on_relevant.label: Reply to relevant group messages
builder.setting.reply_on_relevant.descri: Let the bot evaluate non-@ messages against recent group context and stay silent ([NO_REPLY]) when not relevant.
builder.setting.cooldown_sec.label: Group cooldown (seconds)
builder.setting.cooldown_sec.description: Minimum gap between direct replies in the same group. 0 disables cooldown.
builder.setting.proactive_cooldown_sec.d: Minimum gap between unprompted passive replies in the same group. 0 disables.
builder.setting.proactive_eval_cooldown_: Minimum gap between passive relevance checks in the same group. 0 disables.
builder.setting.proactive_min_chars.desc: Ignore plain non-@ messages shorter than this many characters during passive checks.
builder.setting.proactive_wait_turns.lab: Turns to wait after bot reply
builder.setting.proactive_wait_turns.des: Require this many member messages after the bot spoke before attempting another proactive reply.
builder.setting.proactive_hourly_max.des: Hourly cap on unprompted passive replies per group session.
builder.setting.store_all_messages.label: Remember skipped group messages
builder.setting.store_all_messages.descr: Retain ordinary group messages in working context and dialogue memory even when the bot stays quiet.
builder.setting.retention_turns.label: Context window (turns)
builder.setting.retention_turns.descript: How many recent turns per group stay in working context.
builder.setting.recall_k.label: Memory recall limit (recall_k)
builder.setting.recall_k.description: Candidate count requested from dialogue memory (text search uses result limit; semantic vector search uses pre-filter top-k).
builder.setting.max_tool_rounds.label: Max tool call rounds
builder.setting.max_tool_rounds.descript: Maximum model tool-calling iterations allowed per turn before forcing a final reply.
builder.setting.timezone_offset_hours.de: UTC hour offset formatted into the system prompt's current timestamp.
